name: IC Sensor — 3.3V, 5V, I2C — SO
description: Sensor IC cluster in surface-mount SO package supporting 3.3V, 5V, and I2C interfaces, represented by part MT6701CT.
selection_hints: Select when needing a 3.3V or 5V surface-mount sensor IC with an I2C interface.
Use for PCB designs specifying an SO-8 3.9x4.9mm 1.27mm pitch footprint.
Verify design suitability with tier A representative part MT6701CT.
avoid_when: Avoid if the design requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
Avoid if operating supply voltages other than 3.3V or 5V are required.
Avoid when a package family or footprint other than SO / SO-8 is needed.
Avoid if communication interfaces other than I2C are required.
